ge.wd1: F*ck the Small Talk on Monday, English comedy on Tuesday and Wednesday, and Noël au Quai's opening plus Drink, Paint & Meet on Thursday; rain likely Wednesday and Thursday.
ge.we1: The Garderobes slow-fashion fair in Carouge, Drink and Draw and the Plainpalais flea market on Saturday, a makers' market at the Jonction on Sunday, and Noël au Quai all weekend; rain likely most days.
ge.wd2: A writers' workshop on Tuesday, a language exchange at the Halles de l'Île on Wednesday, a free community choir and a clay-and-face-yoga night on Thursday, and Lancy's Christmas market from Wednesday; rain likely most days.
ge.we2: Annecy's Christmas market opens, the Marché des ressources and the Pâquis craft Christmas market, the Plainpalais flea market and a Fast Friends meet-up on Saturday.

zh.wd1: A beginners' pottery course on Monday, Kon-Tiki comedy on Tuesday, a mixed-media workshop on Wednesday, and the Christmas markets plus a free Kunsthaus opening on Thursday; rain likely Wednesday and Thursday.
zh.we1: Blickfang design fair at the Kongresshaus, Circus Conelli's Christmas season opening, a Craft Brunch and free English comedy on Sunday, and all of Zurich's Christmas markets; rain likely most days.
zh.wd2: Arlo Parks and Kon-Tiki comedy on Tuesday, Sketch Circle on Wednesday, Drawing Animals at the Zoological Museum on Thursday, and Basel's and Winterthur's Christmas markets opening Thursday; rain likely most days.
zh.we2: Le Dolzze art bazaar, pottery and watercolour workshops, Bern's and Einsiedeln's Christmas markets opening, and day trips to the Colmar and Strasbourg markets.

a-ge-f-ck-the-small-talk-geneva-15-11-16.desc: A guided evening of deeper conversations with strangers, using question cards to skip the small talk. Ages 22–49; a paid ticket is required.

a-ge-the-comedy-line-presents-craig-card.desc: An evening of music and English comedy at El Catrín with award-winning Canadian singer-songwriter Craig Cardiff and comedian Jenna Clarke.

a-ge-drink-paint-and-meet-peoples-11-19.desc: A creative after-work: paint your own tote bag over a drink and meet new people. Materials provided.

a-zh-learn-the-basics-of-pottery-beginne.desc: A four-week beginners' pottery course at Ceramics on Wheels: learn hand-building and wheel basics and take your pieces home.

a-zh-atelier-workshop-mischtechnik-11-18.desc: A guided mixed-media art workshop at KreativWerkstatt: experiment freely with colours, shapes and materials. Registration required.

a-zh-comedy-brew-english-stand-up-two-mi.desc: Zurich's weekly English stand-up open mic near Central: about ten comedians a night, from pros testing new jokes to first-timers.

a-ge-atelier-pictura-espace-du-quartier-.desc: An evening life-drawing session with a model at the Saint-Jean community space; bring your own drawing materials.

a-ge-carousing-in-carouge-11-18.desc: A casual evening meetup for drinks and conversation in Carouge, Geneva's charming old quarter.

a-ge-mah-pause-cre-ative-11-22.desc: A drop-in creative paper workshop with Superpapier at the Musée d'art et d'histoire, open all afternoon.

a-zh-knit-n-sip-11-17.desc: A relaxed evening of knitting over drinks; bring your project and meet fellow crafters.

a-ge-vide-grenier-11-22.desc: A pre-Christmas car-boot-style sale run by the Val d'Arve women's club, with crêpes, cakes and sandwiches on sale.

a-ge-marche-des-cre-ateur-icexs-11-22.desc: A Sunday makers' market at the Jardins de la Jonction: local, handmade and artisanal products, ideal for Christmas gifts.

a-ge-language-exchange-geneva-11-25.desc: A weekly language exchange at the Halles de l'Île: swap languages over a drink and meet friendly locals and expats. Free to join.

a-ge-atelier-face-night-yoga-du-visage-m.desc: A playful evening at La Nativa with Renaissance Studio: face-yoga exercises and modelling a face in clay, with drinks.

a-zh-sketch-circle-zu-rich-dr-brauwolf-1.desc: Sketch Circle Zürich's monthly meet-up at Dr. Brauwolf brewery: local artists and friends draw together over a beer. All levels welcome.

a-zh-drawing-animals-11-26.desc: An evening sketching session at the Zoological Museum: the host demonstrates pencil and colour-pencil techniques, then you draw the animals.

a-ge-acroyoga-jams-in-lausanne-11-23.desc: An open acroyoga jam in Lausanne: partner balances and flying for all levels, a friendly way to meet people.

a-ge-acroyoga-jams-in-lausanne-11-20.desc: An open acroyoga jam in Lausanne: partner balances and flying for all levels, a friendly way to meet people.

a-ge-acroyoga-jams-in-lausanne-11-27.desc: An open acroyoga jam in Lausanne: partner balances and flying for all levels, a friendly way to meet people.

a-zh-westlife-11-26.desc: Irish pop group Westlife bring their greatest hits tour to the Hallenstadion.

a-zh-noah-kahan-11-25.desc: American folk-pop singer Noah Kahan plays the Hallenstadion on his The Great Divide world tour.

a-zh-elektra-11-26.desc: Richard Strauss's intense one-act opera Elektra, based on Sophocles' tragedy, at the Zurich Opera House.

a-zh-elektra-11-22.desc: Richard Strauss's intense one-act opera Elektra, based on Sophocles' tragedy, at the Zurich Opera House.

a-ge-marche-des-ressources-11-28.desc: A weekend market at the Ancienne Poste des Charmilles for second-hand materials, upcycled objects and creative supplies.

a-ge-marche-des-ressources-11-29.desc: A weekend market at the Ancienne Poste des Charmilles for second-hand materials, upcycled objects and creative supplies.

a-ge-marche-de-noe-l-artisanal-et-associ.desc: The Pâquis neighbourhood's craft and charity Christmas market, with handmade gifts and stalls from over fifteen local associations.
The Pâquis neighbourhood's craft and charity Christmas market, with handmade gifts and stalls from over fifteen local associations.

a-ge-marche-aux-puces-brocante-de-plainp.desc: Geneva's big flea market on the Plaine de Plainpalais: vintage clothes, furniture, books and curiosities. Dog-friendly; come early.

a-zh-papa-roach-11-30.desc: American rock band Papa Roach live at the Hallenstadion.

a-zh-bryan-adams-11-27.desc: Canadian rock legend Bryan Adams plays his hits at the Hallenstadion.

add.title: Blickfang Zürich — design fair
add.desc: Independent design fair at the Kongresshaus: furniture, jewellery, fashion and homeware sold directly by the designers who make them.

add.when: Thu 19 Nov – Thu 24 Dec · daily from 11:00/12:00
add.title: Noël au Quai — Geneva's lakeside Christmas market
add.desc: Geneva's big Christmas market on the lakefront: wooden chalets, street food, a fondue chalet, a Christmas pub and a carousel. Opens 19 Nov from 17:00.

add.title: Montreux Noël — Christmas market on the lake
add.desc: One of Switzerland's best-known Christmas markets, with over 150 chalets along the lakefront, a flying Santa and extra stalls up at Château de Chillon and Rochers-de-Naye.

add.when: Weekends from Sat 7 Nov · Sat 12:00–20:00, Sun 10:00–18:00
add.title: Uetliberger Weihnachtsmarkt — Christmas market on Zurich's mountain
add.desc: Weekend-only Christmas market at the top of the Uetliberg, with craft stalls, mulled wine and views over the city; easy to combine with a short walk.

add.title: Polarzauber — Christmas market in Zürich HB
add.desc: One of Europe's biggest indoor Christmas markets fills the main station hall around a giant decorated tree, with gift stalls, food and bars.

add.title: Bellevue Noël — Christmas village on Sechseläutenplatz
add.desc: The new name for the old Wienachtsdorf: a Christmas village in front of the Opera House with craft chalets, food, a fondue chalet and a bar open late.

add.title: Weihnachtsmarkt Münsterhof
add.desc: A smaller, pretty Christmas market on the square by the Fraumünster church, with gifts, crafts and mulled wine.

add.when: Thu 19 Nov – Wed 23 Dec · weekdays from 16:00, weekends from 13:00
add.title: Singing Christmas Tree & market, Werdmühleplatz
add.desc: Choirs sing from a giant tree-shaped stage several times a day, surrounded by a small market and a fondue chalet.

add.title: Weihnachtsmarkt Dörfli in the Niederdorf
add.desc: Christmas stalls along the cobbled old-town lanes of the Niederdorf, good for small gifts and a stroll.

add.title: Zürcher Weihnachtsallee at Europaallee
add.desc: A Christmas avenue next to the main station with chalets, a Glühstube and a fondue chalet; opens 19 Nov at 16:00.

add.title: Garderobes — slow fashion fair
add.place: Salle des Fêtes de Carouge, Carouge
add.desc: Third edition of Geneva's sustainable fashion fair: second-hand and local designer clothing, repair and upcycling ideas, all under one roof.

add.title: Lancy Christmas market
add.desc: A small, friendly Christmas market next to Lancy-Pont-Rouge station, with evening opening on weekdays for an after-work mulled wine.

add.title: Bô Noël — Lausanne's Christmas markets
add.place: Place Saint-François, Flon and old town, Lausanne
add.desc: Lausanne's festive season: Christmas markets, light installations and bars spread across several squares in the city centre.

add.title: Basler Weihnachtsmarkt — Basel Christmas market
add.desc: One of Switzerland's most beautiful Christmas markets, spread over two old-town squares with crafts, food stalls and a festive atmosphere.

add.when: Thu 26 Nov – Wed 23 Dec · Mon–Thu 11:00–20:00, Fri–Sat to 20:30, Sun to 19:00
add.title: Winterthurer Weihnachtsmarkt
add.desc: Christmas market in Winterthur's car-free old town, five minutes' walk from the station; crafts, mulled wine and festive lights.

add.title: Winterthurer Wintermarkt
add.desc: A relaxed winter market with food, drinks and fire pits, open late on weekday evenings; cashless payment only.

add.title: Circus Conelli — Zurich's Christmas circus
add.desc: Zurich's much-loved Christmas circus in a heated tent on the Bauschänzli island by Bürkliplatz: acrobats, clowns and live music. Several shows a day; tickets via Ticketcorner.

add.title: Gratis Comedy Zum Mitnehmen — free English stand-up
add.desc: A free Sunday-night English stand-up show where comedians try out new material. A relaxed way to end the weekend.

add.title: Ralph Lemon & Kevin Beasley — exhibition opening at Kunsthaus
add.desc: Free opening evening of the Kunsthaus's new show pairing American artists Ralph Lemon and Kevin Beasley, working across sculpture, sound and performance.

add.title: St. Gallen Christmas market — City of Stars
add.place: Old town around the Abbey, St. Gallen
add.desc: St. Gallen's old town glows under hundreds of star lights, with a Christmas market below the UNESCO-listed Abbey. Easy day trip from Zurich.

add.title: Bern Christmas markets — Münsterplatz & Waisenhausplatz
add.desc: Bern's Christmas markets in front of the cathedral and on Waisenhausplatz: handmade crafts, mulled wine and the UNESCO old town's arcades for rainy moments.

add.title: Einsiedeln Christmas market at the Abbey
add.desc: One of Switzerland's biggest Christmas markets, with around 150 stalls spread in front of the baroque Einsiedeln Abbey. Check exact dates before travelling.

add.title: Lucerne Christmas market
add.desc: Lucerne's cosy Christmas market in the old town, with crafts, mulled wine and a short walk to the lake and Chapel Bridge.

add.title: Rapperswil Christmas market
add.desc: A pretty lakeside Christmas market in Rapperswil's old town below the castle, open Thursday to Sunday.

add.title: Annecy Christmas market — Noël des Alpes
add.desc: Annecy's big Christmas market with around 200 chalets of Alpine food and crafts along the canals and lake; an easy day trip from Geneva.

add.title: Carouge Christmas market
add.desc: Carouge's three-day Christmas market on its pretty Italian-style market square: local makers, crafts, food and mulled wine.
